title: The Phantom Piper
text: While walking through the underground vaults, the temperature suddenly dropped. I heard the faint, echoing sound of bagpipes coming from a walled-off tunnel, but there was absolutely no one else down there.

title: The River Mist
text: I was walking near the ghats late at night. The fog rolling off the river suddenly gathered together and took the shape of a tall figure standing completely still on the water's surface before dissolving.

title: Footsteps in the Attic
text: Staying in a historic bed and breakfast. Every night exactly at 2:45 AM, heavy boots would pace back and forth directly above my bed. The owner confirmed the next morning that the attic has been sealed shut for decades.

title: Whispers in the Ruins
text: We lingered near the main gate just as the sun went down. The wind stopped completely, but clear as day, a woman's voice whispered right into my left ear. I turned around and my friends were 50 feet away.

title: The Train That Never Arrived
text: Waiting alone at an abandoned Tube platform. I felt the rush of wind and heard the screech of brakes of an approaching train. The doors opened, but there was no train visible. Just an empty, dark tunnel.

title: The Compass Spin
text: We were hiking on the main trail. My digital compass started spinning wildly, and my phone battery drained from 80% to zero in three seconds. When I looked up, a shadow darted between the trees.

title: Room 502
text: Taking a guided tour through the old hospital. I snapped a quick photo with the flash on. When I reviewed it later, there was a clear silhouette of a nurse standing right behind the tour guide.

location: Cape of Good Hope, South Africa
title: The Glowing Ship
text: Looking out over the water during a severe storm. For a brief moment during a lightning flash, I saw the massive outline of a 17th-century galleon glowing with a faint red light, struggling against the waves.

title: The Plague Bell
text: The island has been abandoned for years and the bell tower was stripped. Yet, while on a boat a mile offshore, all four of us clearly heard a heavy church bell tolling three times.

title: The Hotel Party
text: Walking past the empty ballroom of the Stanley Hotel. I could hear glasses clinking and big band music playing faintly. I pushed open the heavy wooden doors and the room was completely empty and dark.
